Entry requirements · 2027 entry

LLB Law at University of Edinburgh

What University of Edinburgh asks of applicants to LLB Law for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Edinburgh courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 1 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: three test scores in different subjects are required as a minimum — three AP scores at 4+, or ACT 27+ (single sitting) plus two AP scores at 4+, or SAT 1290+ (650+ Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, 620+ Math) plus two AP scores at 4+
  • SAT/ACT is not required when three AP scores at 4+ are offered
  • Applicants whose school offers no AP tests: ACT 27+ or SAT 1290 (650+ / 620+) plus a cumulative GPA of 3.3/4.0 or above

Edinburgh’s College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences states that these USA entry requirements are currently under review for entry in September 2027, so they are not confirmed for this cycle.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America · Edinburgh College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences: USA entry requirements
English language
  • IELTS Academic: 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component (IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted)
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 92 overall with at least 20 in each component (tests before 21 January 2026)
    • 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in each component (tests from 21 January 2026)
    • TOEFL MyBest not accepted
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 176 overall with at least 162 in each component
    • Oxford ELLT: 7 overall with at least 5 in each component
    • Oxford Test of English Advanced: 145 overall with at least 125 in each component
  • IELTS, TOEFL iBT and Oxford tests must be no more than two years old at the programme start date
  • US nationals (a majority English-speaking country) can instead use, for example, Grade 11 English at C, ACT 25 in both English and Reading, or SAT 650 in Reading and Writing

Trinity ISE is listed for 2026 entry only; Edinburgh says it is reviewing Trinity ISE for 2027 entry.

Verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Law (Ordinary and Honours) LLB entry requirements · Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

The 2027-entry entry-requirements page lists no admissions test for this programme; Edinburgh’s only programme-specific test mentioned is the UCAT for Medicine. Partly verified: Edinburgh’s interviews, tests and portfolios page still refers to the UCAT “in 2025” (the previous cycle).

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Interviews, tests and portfolios
Subject prerequisites
  • Required:
    • English — A level English Literature, English Language or combined English at B (or GCSE English Language and English Literature both at A or 7)
    • IB HL English at 5

English is required (A level English Literature, English Language or combined English at B, or GCSE English Language and English Literature both at A or 7); because of the GCSE alternative the engine holds English as preferred, not essential. History is not listed. IB HL English at 5 is quoted in the IB row, not here.

Applied ICT, Applied Science, Communication and Culture, Creative Writing, General Studies, Journalism in the Media and Communications Industry, Leisure Studies, Media: Communication and Production, Performing Arts, Travel and Tourism
Contextual offer
ABB — minimum entry requirement for widening access Plus Flag applicants (UK permanent residents only)

Standard entry requirement from A*A*A to A*AA, including English Literature, English Language or combined English at B (GCSE English Language and English Literature both at A or 7 are accepted instead), so English is held as preferred. The engine holds A*AA, the bottom of the range. Edinburgh describes its standard entry requirements as the grades most applicants needed to receive an offer in recent years; offers may be made above or below them, and never below the widening-access minimum.

Standard entry requirement from 40 points with 766 at HL to 37 points with 666 at HL, including HL English at 5 (the engine cannot hold an HL English requirement). 39 points (engine) is inside the range but not a published figure. Edinburgh describes its standard entry requirements as the grades most applicants needed to receive an offer in recent years; offers may be made above or below them, and never below the widening-access minimum.
